## Context
2 to 4 lines, with a link to the relevant section of docs/PROJECT.md (do not paste the spec).

## Goal
One sentence.

## Scope
In scope / out of scope.

## Read first
The files and doc sections to read before coding. Only what is needed.

## Files likely touched
...

## Interfaces
Consumes: what this ticket uses from its dependencies.
Provides: what later tickets rely on (names, signatures, CLI, file formats).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] command and expected outcome

## Dependencies
Depends on: #X, #Y (or "none"). Epic: #E.

## Allowed assumptions
What may be assumed and documented in the handoff instead of asking.

## Definition of done
Acceptance commands pass, code review has no open blocking findings, the PR closes this issue, and a `## Handoff` comment is posted here.
